defaultSB.label: Default Scene Behavior
defaultSB.hint: Whether scenes should default to auto changing token levels based on elevation.

defaultAE.label: Default Absolute Elevation
defaultAE.hint: Whether scenes should default to using absolute elevation instead of relative.

defaultLI.label: Default Level Inclusion
defaultLI.hint: Whether levels should be included by default as options for auto level changes.

defaultLN.label: Default Level Nav Visibility
defaultLN.hint: Whether levels should be hidden from GALC's level navigation for players by default.

notify.label: Display Notifications?
notify.hint: Should GALC provide informative notifications every time a token's level is changed.

navDisplay.label: Use GALC Levels Navigation
navDisplay.hint: For whom GALC should display its own levels navigation instead of the core version.

navElevation.label: Include Elevations in Nav
navElevation.hint: If using GALC's level navigation, should each level's elevations be displayed in it.

hud.label: HUD Absolute Elevation
hud.hint: Where and if absolute elevation should be added as an input in the token HUD.

preload.label: Preload Adjacent Levels?
preload.hint: Should assets from adjacent levels be preloaded every time viewed level changes.

delay.label: Multi-Select Delay
delay.hint: Delay (in ms) before re-grabbing control of multiple tokens.

scene.label: Auto Level Change
scene.hint: Whether tokens in this scene should change level automatically based on elevation.

abs.label: Absolute Elevation
abs.hint: Whether tokens in this scene should display absolute elevation instead of relative.

level.label: Level Change Inclusion
level.hint: Whether this level should be included for potential auto level changes.

nav.label: Level Nav Visibility
nav.hint: Whether this level should display in GALC's level navigation for players.

navName.label: Level Nav Name
navName.hint: An alternative name to show to players in notifications and levels navigation.

group.label: Level Group Name
group.hint: If set, auto level changes only happen between levels with a matching name.

notify.label: Display Level Info
notify.hint: When used, gives a notification with selected token's level and absolute elevation.

notifications.change: {token}'s level changed to {level}. {token}'s absolute elevation is {elevation} {units}.
